title: Maximum deflection voltage
description: Essential: The student must state the correct voltage U = 400 V for maximum deflection angle.

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important: The solution must apply kinematics in the electric field to relate vertical acceleration, plate length, and initial velocity.

title: Velocity after electric field
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the final speed v after acceleration, using v = v0 / cosθ or energy methods.

title: Magnetic force balance
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law with the Lorentz force (qvB = mv²/r) to find cyclotron radius.

title: PQ width for n=1
description: Essential: The student must correctly derive the width of the impact region on PQ, likely as 2(r2 - r1) or similar.

title: Time for infinite n
description: Essential: The student must state the correct time t = 2 × 10⁻⁵ s for the particle traversing the magnetic field region.

title: Path length geometry
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must recognize the effective path length s' = s / cosθ in the magnetic field.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses the direction of electric/magnetic forces or misassigns charge polarity.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if final answers lack correct units (Volts, seconds) or have major unit conversion errors.
